questions.question: What does the name BTS stand for in Korean?
questions.fun_fact: Bangtan Sonyeondan means Bulletproof Boy Scouts. Since July 2017 the letters also stand for Beyond the Scene. Source: Wikipedia.

questions.question: What is the official name of the BTS fandom?
questions.fun_fact: BTS picked the name A.R.M.Y. for their fan club at their first fan meeting in Seoul, in 2014. Source: Wikipedia.

questions.question: In which year did BTS debut?
questions.fun_fact: BTS made their stage debut on 13 June 2013 on M Countdown, performing No More Dream. Source: Wikipedia.

questions.question: Which member is the leader of BTS?
questions.fun_fact: RM is a rapper, songwriter and producer. Big Hit first planned a hip hop group around him before BTS became an idol group. Source: Wikipedia.

questions.question: Which song was the first English-language single of BTS, released in August 2020?
questions.fun_fact: Dynamite debuted at number one on the Billboard Hot 100, the first chart-topper for BTS and for an all-South Korean act. Source: Billboard.

questions.question: What was the title of the debut single album of BTS?
questions.fun_fact: 2 Cool 4 Skool came out in June 2013 with the lead single No More Dream. It opened their school trilogy. Source: Wikipedia.

questions.question: Which BTS album was the first to sell one million copies in South Korea?
options: The Most Beautiful Moment in Life: Young Forever
questions.fun_fact: Wings (2016) was inspired by the Hermann Hesse novel Demian. Source: Wikipedia.

questions.question: Which BTS album was the first K-pop album to top the US Billboard 200?
questions.fun_fact: Love Yourself: Tear debuted at number one on the Billboard 200 in 2018, the first number-one album of BTS in the US. Source: Wikipedia.

questions.question: Which American singer is featured on the BTS single Boy with Luv?
questions.fun_fact: Boy with Luv led the 2019 EP Map of the Soul: Persona. BTS then became the first K-pop act to perform on Saturday Night Live. Source: Wikipedia.

questions.question: Which band released the 2021 single My Universe with BTS?
questions.fun_fact: My Universe debuted at number one on the Billboard Hot 100 in September 2021. Source: Wikipedia.

questions.question: Which song was the first entry of BTS on the Billboard Hot 100?
questions.fun_fact: DNA entered the Hot 100 at number 85 in 2017, making BTS the first K-pop boy band to reach that chart. Source: Wikipedia.

questions.question: Which BTS song was the first song performed mainly in Korean to top the Billboard Hot 100?
questions.fun_fact: Life Goes On led the 2020 album Be and was the third US number-one single of BTS in three months. Source: Wikipedia.

questions.question: In 2018, BTS became the first Korean act to perform at a US stadium. Which one?
questions.fun_fact: The New York show at Citi Field was the final North American stop of the Love Yourself world tour. Source: Wikipedia.

questions.question: Which organisation named BTS its Global Recording Artist of the Year for 2020?
questions.fun_fact: BTS were the first Asian and the first non-English-speaking act to top the IFPI ranking. Source: Wikipedia.

questions.question: What is the title of the March 2026 BTS album, their first group album in almost four years?
questions.fun_fact: Arirang came out on 20 March 2026 with the lead single Swim and spent two weeks at number one on the Billboard 200. Source: Wikipedia.
